description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0021. Canonical N-Quads: every node has an IRI, computed inverses are materialised, lines are sorted by their serialised bytes and each is terminated by a single LF. Because the dataset is blank-node-free, canonicalisation is this sort.
reason: AGSC-04-15 was amended at rc.6 (PY2-01) to pin the graph term of every line of graph.nq as the Bundle IRI; this case states its lines as triples in the default graph, which that rule now excludes. The corrected case ships as graph-0021 (AGSC-00-16: a released vector is never edited in place).
